mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2 < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp+ unemployment rate spike, or the unemployment rate explains < 5% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2 < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 3-month periods following a 2%+ industrial production drop, or industrial production explains < 10% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2 < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts signals a strong housing market and consumer spending that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of 6-month periods following a 5%+ rise in housing starts, or housing starts explain < 5% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2 < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 3-month periods following a 1%+ federal funds rate hike, or the federal funds rate explains < 10% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2 < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment signals a rapidly weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 200k+ payroll employment drop, or payroll employment explains < 5% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2 < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in consumer prices signals rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following a 0.5%+ CPI rise, or CPI explains < 5% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2 < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real estate sales signals a weakening housing market and consumer spending that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 3-month periods following a 10%+ drop in real estate sales, or real estate sales explain < 10% of SPX return variation over any 3-year window (R^2 < 0.1).
